description: Fuse the sign-DC stage boundaries for shape 11 to cut inter-stage HBM traffic: the pipeline runs sign-iterations -> projector-apply -> CholeskyQR2 -> reduced-block eigh -> back-transform as separate launches, each materializing large n x n / n x k intermediates to HBM and reloading them. Several workers measured GPU-side inter-stage gaps (a wave-drain between the NS GEMMs; launch gaps around proj_cqr). Fuse adjacent producer-consumer stages that share an intermediate: e.g. keep the projector output resident into the Gram build, or fuse the sign-iteration output directly into the projector-apply, so the large intermediate stays in L2/SMEM instead of round-tripping HBM. Targets memory-throughput / launch-overhead across the stage boundaries (distinct from the per-stage precision/kernel work other briefs do); keep the residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback + orthogonality-edge calibration, route guarded per shape.
t1: CQR inv-GEMM (remove wide-transpose HBM round-trips). shape11 70828->113834us (+61% regression): K=300 dense tri-inverse + 3xTF32 GEMM slower than the wide trsm. geomean 27284.5->28309.0.

t2: fuse sign->proj seam, fp16-resident sign iterate (no .float() up-cast). shape11 70828->73550us (+3.8%); the fp16 projector GEMM overlaps the memcpies & isn't the wall lever. orth 0.00027/gate 0.00549, 0/640 fallback. geomean 27284.5->27245.6 (flat).

t3: CQR right-solve (X L^T = Qc) removes 2x786MB wide-transpose round-trips per pass, same FP32 trsm/accuracy. shape11 70828->70288us (-0.76%, flat): the transpose D2D copies overlap the trsm compute -> not on critical path. 39/39 valid. geomean 27284.5->27256.7 (flat).

t4: fuse proj-apply->Gram seam, stacked bases into preallocated buffer (no 786MB cat copy), + t3 right-solve. shape11 70828->70339us (flat): cat copy overlaps compute. 39/39 valid. geomean 27284.5->27271.3 (flat).

t5: JOINT stack fp16-sign+right-solve+stack-proj. shape11 70828->72104us (+1.8%, fp16-sign dominates), 39/39 valid, 0/640 fallback. geomean flat 27301.3. All 3 seam fusions confirm shape 11 is stage-compute-bound (mega_eigh 33%, trsm 13%); the 6.5GB inter-stage D2D traffic overlaps compute.

t6 FINAL keeper: CQR right-solve + stack-proj (fp16-sign OFF). shape11 70828->70380us (flat), geomean 27284.5->27283.8 (identical to parent). 39/39 valid, 0 fallback. Removes ~3.9GB real D2D seam traffic (CQR transposes + proj-CQR cat) with no accuracy loss/no regression; wall-time flat because that traffic overlaps stage compute (mega_eigh 33%, trsm 13%). Shape 11 is stage-compute-bound.

brief-111 (fuse sign-DC stage boundaries, shape 11): 6 trials on branch HEAD 2c3f3a3884. VERDICT: shape 11 is STAGE-COMPUTE-BOUND, not inter-stage-data-movement-bound -- every seam fusion left wall-time flat because the inter-stage HBM traffic OVERLAPS the stage compute. PROFILED (parent nsys, shape 11, span 70868us): mega_eigh_med_split_k=23715us(33.5%), batch_trsm_left=9016us(12.7%), potrf*=3105us. Total D2D memcpy=6503.8MB: 336MBx10 fp16 NS iterate casts + 393MBx2 proj->CQR cat + 786MBx2 CQR wide-transposes/pass + 393MBx2 back-transform. The '~213us wave-drain' a sibling saw between NS GEMMs is actually a 336MB fp16-iterate D2D memcpy running CONCURRENTLY (overlapped, not idle). TRIALS: t1 CQR inv-GEMM (K=300 tri-inverse+3xTF32, remove transposes) shape11 70828->113834us +61% REGRESSION (inverse slower than the wide trsm floor, brief-87 confirmed); t2 fp16-resident sign->proj (remove 671MB .float() up-cast) 70828->73550us +3.8% (fp16 proj GEMM overlaps memcpies, membership recasts Vp/Vm); t3 CQR RIGHT-solve X L^T=Qc (remove wide transposes, SAME trsm/FP32) 70828->70288us FLAT; t4 stacked-projector-into-preallocated-buffer (remove 786MB proj->CQR cat) 70828->70339us FLAT; t5 all-three joint 70828->72104us +1.8%; t6 FINAL keeper = right-solve+stack-proj (fp16-sign off) 70828->70380us FLAT, geomean 27284.5->27283.8 IDENTICAL. FINAL PROFILE (t6, shape11): memcpy 6503.8MB->4930.9MB (-1573MB=-24%, the proj->CQR cat + one 786MB transpose GONE) yet span 70868->70585us (-0.4%, noise) and mega_eigh/trsm/potrf UNCHANGED -- direct proof removing 1.57GB seam traffic doesn't move a compute-bound shape. Margins clean throughout: orth_max 0.00027 vs gate 0.00549, 0/640 fallback, 39/39 valid, no shape regressed. KEEPER t6 removes ~1.57GB real D2D traffic with no accuracy loss and no regression (safe to stack under a compute-reducing win). OPEN DIRECTIONS (all point at the STAGES, which this brief did not own): (1) mega_eigh_med_split_k is a SINGLE 23.7ms kernel = 33.5% of shape 11 -- the dominant lever, owned by the reduced-eigh brief; a faster reduced K=300 eigh (smaller K via tighter sign convergence, or a batched-Jacobi/tensor-core reduced solver) is where the shape's time actually is. (2) batch_trsm_left 9ms/2-passes at the cuBLAS floor -- could a fp16/tf32 trsm or a 1-pass CQR + heavier NS refine cut it (CQR_PASSES is pinned at 2 for rank-safety)? (3) K=300 is oversized; if the sign converges tighter the reduced blocks shrink, cutting BOTH mega_eigh and trsm quadratically -- a precision/iteration-count brief, not a seam brief. (4) a CUSTOM fused projector-Gram-Cholesky kernel keeping the (n,K) basis in L2/SMEM was NOT built (torch-level restructures can't keep it resident across the potrf); only worth it if the basis materialization were on the critical path, which the profile says it is not.
